name: Handaxe Sellsword

abilities.name: Falling Coin
abilities.description: When the sellsword makes a shortsword attack against a creature that is prone, the sellsword can choose to deal maximum damage instead of rolling, ending the prone condition on a hit.

abilities.name: Riposte (Reaction)
abilities.description: *When * A creature within 5 feet of the sellsword misses it with a melee attack roll. *, * The sellsword makes one Handaxe attack against that creature.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sellsword makes three Handaxe attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Shortsword.

actions.name: Handaxe
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage, and the sellsword has advantage on its next attack roll against the target before the end of its next turn. Until the end of the sellsword's next turn, the sellsword has advantage on attack rolls against the target, and the target can't take the Hide action.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage. Immediately after the attack, its handaxe returns to the sellsword's grasp, and the sellsword has advantage on its next attack roll against the target before the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet that the sellsword can see must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw, taking 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage on a failed save. On a failed save, if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is knocked prone.

generation.userConcept: a sellsword who hurls a handaxe and closes with a shortsword

other_edition.lore: A border-company sellsword who fights for coin and drink, throwing his axe to buy the steps that let him close with the sword — and who counts every wound he takes, because no employer pays for a dead blade.
